new_jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Client Accounts Project Manager, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, plays a key role in supporting partners who manage complex client portfolios. This position serves as a trusted liaison among partners, clients, and internal client administration, billing, collections, and accounting teams to support effective financial management, timely communication, and strong client service delivery.

Location

This position can sit in our Atlanta, Baltimore, Boston, Miami, New York, Northern Virginia, Philadelphia, Raleigh, Short Hills, Washington DC, or Wilmington office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day engagement with designated partners, clients, and internal teams to ensure financial administration needs are addressed with accuracy, urgency, and professionalism.
Convert detailed billing, receivables, and matter information into clear business updates, insights, and recommendations that support informed partner and client decision-making.
Produce recurring reporting and financial commentary covering billing activity, collection progress, account status, and related performance trends.
Drive follow-through on outstanding items by coordinating with clients, partners, billing personnel, collections staff, and client administration teams through resolution.
Research and resolve invoice questions, charge allocation issues, budget alignment concerns, and payment barriers in coordination with appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
Support electronic billing by helping address submission errors, reductions, or rejections.
Track accruals, approved budgets, alternative fee arrangements, and matter-level financial activity to identify exceptions, emerging risks, or profitability concerns requiring escalation.
Evaluate aged receivables and open balances, partnering with responsible parties to remove obstacles, strengthen collection efforts, and improve cash flow outcomes.
Maintain ongoing visibility into client payment activity and help execute focused collection strategies that support annual financial goals.
Recommend and implement practical enhancements to workflows, communication practices, reporting methods, and service delivery processes.
Establish reusable guidance, operational standards, and knowledge-sharing resources that promote consistency across the department and support broader strategic initiatives.
Complete additional responsibilities as requested in support of departmental and firm priorities.

Desired Skills  

Strong understanding of legal billing, alternative fee arrangements, matter profitability, realization rates, and client service delivery models. Experience with billing, collections, client accounting, e-billing, budgeting, accruals, legal financial systems, and matter financial management. Ability to perform analysis and reconciliation between cross-jurisdictional billing and financial systems. Experience managing global retainers and multi-jurisdictional matters preferred. Familiarity with legal financial systems such as Aderant and Intapp preferred.

Proficiency in project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Asana, or Trello. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Excellent communication, analytical, relationship-building, problem-solving, and leadership skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights. Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, work effectively with partners, clients, and cross-functional internal teams, and drive consensus. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, follow up consistently, and drive work to completion in a deadline-driven environment. Strategic mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, innovation, operational excellence, and high-quality client service.

Minimum Education   

High School Diploma or GED.

Preferred Education   

Bachelors Degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration or related field.

Certificates

LPM, LPP, LPA, or equivalent project management certification preferred. PMP certificate with legal experience also desirable.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

5 years’ experience in legal financial operations or project management.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties.
Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner.
Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product.
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required.
Foster positive work relationships.
Comply with all firm policies and practices.
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed.
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

10 to 15 year’s experience in progressive project management
Large capital project management experience

Experience negotiating with, and managing contractors

Understanding of financial modeling, and impact of projects on overall business
Governance and risk management experience

Access to a variety of career opportunities across the organization.

Our mission is to be the world’s most valued gold and copper mining business. We are committed to partnering with our host countries and communities to transform their natural resources into tangible benefits and mutual prosperity.

Barrick is a leading global mining, exploration and development company. With one of the largest portfolios of world-class and life-long gold and copper assets in the industry - including six of the world's Tier One gold mines - Barrick's operations an projects span 18 countries and five continents. Barrick is also the largest gold producer in the United States. Nevada Gold Mines (NGM) is a joint venture between Barrick (61.5%) and Newmont (38.5%) that combined our significant assets across Nevada in 2019 to create the single largest gold-producing complex in the world. NGM produces approximately 3.5 million ounces of gold a year. The massive mining operation comprises eight mines along with their associated infrastructure and processing facilities and hosts three of Barrick’s Tier One assets: Carlin, Cortez, and Turquoise Ridge. At NGM, our mission is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and owning the best assets, with the best people, to deliver sustainable returns for our owners and partners.

new_jobs.title: Scrum Master / Project Manager – Agile Transformatie
new_jobs.description:
Scrum Master / Project Manager – Agile Transformatie

Locatie:
Utrecht – 2 dagen per week op locatie
Uren:
40 uur per week
Start:
Zo snel mogelijk

Over de rol

Voor een urgent IT-project binnen een grote publieke organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren Scrum Master / Project Manager die projectmanagement en Agile/Scrum uitstekend kan combineren.

De functie bestaat uit twee duidelijke fases.

In de eerste fase ligt de nadruk voornamelijk op projectmanagement, voortgang en delivery. Je zorgt ervoor dat het project op koers blijft, doelstellingen worden behaald, acties worden opgevolgd en stakeholders duidelijk weten wat er van hen wordt verwacht.
Naarmate het project richting de releasefase beweegt, verschuift de focus steeds meer naar de rol van Scrum Master. Je begeleidt het team in de Agile/Scrum-werkwijze, faciliteert de samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat impediments tijdig worden weggenomen.
We zoeken daarom iemand die Scrum niet alleen vanuit theorie kent, maar ook praktisch, resultaatgericht en besluitvaardig is.

Wat ga je doen?

In de eerste fase projectmatig leidinggeven aan het traject.
Bewaken van doelstellingen, acties, voortgang en deadlines.
Zorgen dat gemaakte afspraken worden nagekomen.
Bewaken van de planning en tijdig bijsturen waar nodig.
Signaleren, oplossen en escaleren van blokkades en risico's.
Afstemmen met verschillende stakeholders en projectbetrokkenen.
Verzorgen van duidelijke communicatie over voortgang, afhankelijkheden en actiepunten.
Faciliteren van Scrum-events zoals Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Reviews en Retrospectives.
Het team ondersteunen bij het toepassen van Scrum- en Agile-principes.
Bevorderen van samenwerking, transparantie en eigenaarschap binnen het team.
Bewaken van de voortgang richting release.
In de releasefase steeds meer optreden als volwaardig Scrum Master.
Waar nodig stakeholders aanspreken en zorgen dat beslissingen en acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd.

Wat zoeken wij?

Je bent stressbestendig, stevig in je schoenen en praktisch ingesteld. Je houdt overzicht wanneer de druk toeneemt, communiceert duidelijk en durft mensen aan te spreken wanneer dat nodig is om resultaten te behalen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master en/of Project Manager.
Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding.
Een PSM I-certificering.
Ervaring met het begeleiden van Agile/Scrum-teams.
Sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden.
Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement.
Het vermogen om meerdere prioriteiten en afhankelijkheden tegelijkertijd te bewaken.
Een praktische en resultaatgerichte instelling.
Het vermogen om zowel faciliterend als sturend op te treden.
Beschikbaarheid voor 40 uur per week.
Bereidheid om 2 dagen per week in Utrecht te werken.

Een PSM II-certificering is geen vereiste. Er zijn mogelijkheden om deze certificering gedurende de samenwerking verder te behalen.

Wie past goed bij deze functie?

Deze rol past goed bij een Scrum Master met enkele jaren ervaring die een volgende stap wil zetten en meer verantwoordelijkheid wil nemen voor zowel Agile teams als projectresultaten.
Je hoeft geen tientallen jaren ervaring te hebben. Belangrijker is dat je aantoonbaar verantwoordelijkheid hebt genomen voor projecten, teams, planning en delivery.
Je bent iemand die verder gaat dan alleen het faciliteren van Scrum-events. Je weet wanneer je moet faciliteren, wanneer je moet bijsturen en wanneer je moet escaleren.
Kortom: een professional die mensen en processen kan verbinden én verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor voortgang en resultaat.

Procedure

Vanwege de urgentie wordt er snel geschakeld.
De procedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken:
Een eerste gesprek met de IT-dienstverlener.
Een vervolggesprek met de publieke eindorganisatie.

Bij een goede match kan het proces op korte termijn worden doorlopen en is een snelle start mogelijk

new_jobs.title: Program Manager (One Year Term)
new_jobs.description:
Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary range available for this position at the time of its posting. The salary range is between $49,257 and $62,311, depending on qualifications, experience, department budgets, and industry data.

Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.

POSITION OBJECTIVE

Our research in Alzheimer's disease aims to identify genetic factors associated with dementia, specifically Alzheimer's type. We are focused on increasing the representation of our study population by enrolling individuals from various ancestries. Through this, we seek to better understand the genetic underpinnings of memory loss and dementia. By collecting comprehensive data and biological samples, we will conduct genetic studies to identify potential genetic markers for dementia. The Program Manager will play a key role in managing these efforts, including participant recruitment, enrollment, and data oversight, while collaborating with study sites to ensure the success of recruitment and data collection initiatives. This is a full-time, 1 year term position.

Essential Functions

Identify and enroll eligible individuals and meet enrollment goals. Cultivate relationships with potential study participants; providing education, building trust and promoting interest in study activities. Work within human research protection processes: create and maintain appropriate protocol documents, confidentially and sensitively obtain and review family and medical histories and perform study specific interviews, instruments, and exams and identify, obtain and review appropriate medical records. Draw blood for genetic studies (training can be provided on the job). Prepare detailed participant exam reports for adjudication. Oversee and maintain complete research files and comprehensive databases including: consent forms, demographics, family and medical history forms and all other study specific forms and data. Document and maintain records to show effort that may not be reflected in enrollment numbers; events attended, sign-ups, declines, phone calls, messages left, etc. Ensure compliance with IRB approved protocols and maintain data integrity. (70%)
Collaborate with study leadership to create strategic approaches to identify and engage community and clinic partnerships. Build community partnerships through effective outreach efforts. Develop and implement community recruitment strategy and methods. Design and manage community events; reach out to various groups including but not limited to the Alzheimer's association, churches, community senior centers, social groups and caregiver support groups. Maintain open communication with physicians and office staff participating in the studies in the community. Working closely with the research staff, monitor and oversee research activities for the ascertainment, recruitment and enrollment of study participants for the DAWN study and ensure timelines and goals are met. Evaluate outreach efforts, identify areas for improvement, advise leadership of alternative methods/efforts, and implement adjustments. (10%)
Facilitate communication and provide regular research updates for meetings. Work with the team to prepare a yearly participant newsletter. Participate in research group meetings locally and with the national network and communicate with the Research Project Director and Principal Investigators to ensure that work on the studies is being performed as needed and expected. Attend regular meetings locally and nationally with the principal investigators/coordinators and collaborators. Maintain open communication/collaboration between departments within and outside of institution. (10%)
Provide training and instruction regarding enrollment and data entry procedures for others working on the study. (7%)

Nonessential Functions

May serve as a co-author on research publications. (1%)
Provide training regarding enrollment and data entry procedures for others who work with the studies. May supervise students and technicians. (1%)
Perform other duties as assigned. (1%)

CONTACTS

Department: On-going contact with supervisor. Contact with Research Project Director and PI as needed, staff, faculty, postdocs, and study participants. Will work closely with any other team members who work on the same study, coordinate research activities for the ascertainment, recruitment, and enrollment of study participants for the human genetics research studies in their area.

University: Contact as needed with purchasing, human resources, space, and facilities planning, environmental health, safety/contact, Research Administration, IRB, and Sponsored Projects Accounting.

External: Regular contact with community leaders, collaborators at other universities, institutions, and industry. Occasional contact with vendors.

Students: On-going contact with students.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

This position has no direct supervision of staff employees. May train new staff; direct the work of students.

Qualifications

Experience 2 to 5 years of experience with minority community and familiarity with the aging population, preferably in the Cleveland area;

Education: Bachelor's degree required. Prefer Nursing degree. Must have and maintain a valid driver's license and be able to travel to participant homes, exam locations and community events, primarily within the local area.

Required Skills

Ability to concisely and effectively communicate methods, concepts, and study designs to all groups as appropriate, relevant and indicated.
Effective and professional interpersonal skills. Demonstrated expertise and strong leadership skills in team-oriented environment.
Ability to facilitate open communication/collaboration between department and other areas, as well as open communication with physicians and office staff participating in the studies in the community.
Maintain level of confidentiality commensurate with nature of involvement with study participants, medical records and other sensitive HIPAA, demographic and family history information.
Good problem solving and decision-making skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated willingness to be hands-on and pro-active.
Ability to multitask, work independently, and set own priorities, while maintaining accuracy and attention to details.
Ability to work effectively with internal and external colleagues and collaborators. Ability to interact with colleagues, supervisors, and customers face to face.
Ability to meet consistent attendance.
Phlebotomy skills preferred, but training will be provided to attain those skills.
Ability to demonstrate successful support, education, and advocacy for all students, aligned with the values, mission, and messaging of the university, while adhering to the staff policy on conflict of commitment and interest.
Willingness to learn and work with artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Normal office environment. Employee will need to drive a personal vehicle to participants¿ home and exam locations and community events. (approximately 50%-75% of travel required). Occasional national/international travel for collaborative meetings. May need to work on occasional weekends and during evenings to attend and participate in community/recruitment events.

This is a Term position. They are treated like regular staff positions for medical and dental benefits eligibility, vacation, holidays, and sick time. Term employees are not eligible for life insurance, retirement, long term disability, short term disability, tuition assistance, layoff status, or severance pay. Staff in term positions are also subject to the performance management review process and positive corrective action when work performance or behavior is unsatisfactory or unacceptable. Term employment does not alter the employment-at-will employee status of these employees.

This position is eligible for hybrid work arrangement up to two remote days per week at the discretion of the department. new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Ireland PMCM Rail)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

We are a diverse, inclusive and enthusiastic team of Project, Commercial and Design Managers working across the Irish rail sector, united by a shared purpose: delivering sustainable, resilient transport solutions for communities across Ireland. Our passion comes from shaping the built environment through high‑quality, tailored project delivery as we strive to be best in class.

As a Senior Project Manager within WSP’s PMCM Rail team in Ireland
, you will lead the delivery of complex rail projects of regional and national significance. These may include heavy rail, light rail and metro schemes that play a critical role in Ireland’s future transport infrastructure. You will ensure projects are delivered safely, to a high standard of quality, on programme and within budget.

At WSP, our Senior Project Managers are people who make a difference. You will proactively manage requirements, budgets, schedules and risk, and influence multi‑disciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes together. You will bring strong technical capability, clear communication and a collaborative, problem‑solving approach, with the confidence to take on new challenges.

You will work closely with key Irish Clients and partners such as Iarnród Éireann, the National Transport Authority (NTA), Transport Infrastructure Ireland (TII), Luas operators and local authorities
, collaborating with WSP’s multidisciplinary teams across Ireland and the wider UK & Ireland region. Delivery will be managed from WSP offices, client offices and site locations, depending on project needs.

Our culture actively supports work‑life balance, and we encourage flexible working arrangements. You will be based in one of our modern offices in Naas
, Dublin, or Belfast
, with an expectation of working in the office a minimum of three days per week to support collaboration with colleagues and Clients. Site visits will form part of the role as required.

At WSP, you will have the opportunity to take the next step in your career, building on your experience and achieving your professional ambitions. We offer strong support for personal development and progression, both locally and across WSP’s global business, including opportunities to gain or progress professional project management qualifications.

A Little More About Your Role…

Coordinating multidisciplinary teams through project meetings and target‑led workshops, ensuring critical issues are resolved promptly and projects meet safety, functional and regulatory requirements.
Establishing robust project management processes and governance in collaboration with Client teams.
Acting as the principal point of contact for Clients throughout design and construction phases.
Developing and maintaining strong Client relationships through effective communication and influencing skills.
Producing monthly project reports, forecasts and data‑led insights to provide clarity on project performance to senior stakeholders.
Leading engagement with internal and external stakeholders, including regulators, local authorities and community groups.
Chairing project meetings, presentations and progress reviews.
Managing stakeholder expectations and responding to concerns effectively.
Managing contracts in accordance with agreed rules of engagement, including NEC3/NEC4.
Managing project budgets, cost forecasting, change control and financial performance.
Managing change, risk and delay events, ensuring appropriate mitigations are implemented.
Proactively managing early warnings, RFIs and communications to reduce risk and support successful project delivery.

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…

Strong safety leadership, driving compliance with Irish safety legislation and regulations, including Project Supervisor Design Process (PSDP) and Project Supervisor Construction Stage (PSCS) duties where applicable.
A commitment to environmentally responsible project delivery aligned with WSP’s sustainability values.
Proven experience defining project scope, objectives and deliverables with Clients and stakeholders.
The ability to develop and manage detailed project plans covering programme, budget, resources and risk.
Accountability for project performance, identifying issues early and implementing corrective actions.
A track record of delivering complex rail or transport infrastructure projects in Ireland or comparable regulated environments.
Experience working with multidisciplinary design and construction teams on client‑side or consultancy‑led commissions.
A degree in a relevant discipline such as engineering, construction management, project management or a related field.
Chartered status with, or working towards membership of, a relevant professional body (such as Engineers Ireland, APM, PMA).
Project management qualifications (APM, PMI, PRINCE2, MSP, Six Sigma) are advantageous.
NEC4 Project Manager accreditation is highly desirable.
A collaborative, curious and solutions‑focused mindset, with a strong client‑service ethic.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

new_jobs.description:
About The Company

Oracle is a global technology leader renowned for its comprehensive suite of cloud applications, database management systems, and enterprise software solutions. With a rich history of innovation and a commitment to transforming businesses through cutting-edge technology, Oracle serves a diverse range of industries including finance, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing. The company's mission is to help organizations worldwide harness the power of data and technology to achieve their strategic goals. Oracle's extensive product portfolio, combined with its dedication to customer success and continuous innovation, makes it a trusted partner for businesses seeking scalable and reliable technology solutions.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and independent Business Process Analyst III to join Oracle’s dynamic team. This role is pivotal in driving strategic initiatives by analyzing, designing, and optimizing business processes across various departments. The ideal candidate will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and cross-functional teams, translating complex business objectives into actionable plans and ensuring successful project delivery. Operating remotely, this position offers the opportunity to work in a flexible environment, collaborating with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Go-to-Market, and other business units. While experience in the health industry is advantageous, it is not a mandatory requirement. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills, a process-oriented mindset, and the ability to navigate ambiguity effectively.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of five years of experience in business process analysis, operations, consulting, or related fields. A bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline is preferred; however, equivalent professional experience will be considered. Proficiency in advanced Excel functions, including pivot tables and data analysis, is essential. Strong PowerPoint skills for creating compelling presentations for executive audiences are required. Familiarity with modern AI tools such as ChatGPT and Codex is highly desirable, demonstrating technical curiosity and adaptability. Candidates should demonstrate excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—and possess the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Experience supporting cross-functional initiatives, especially in Go-to-Market or Sales Operations, will be considered an asset. The role demands a proactive, organized individual capable of managing multiple priorities and working independently in a remote setting.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Partner closely with leadership and business stakeholders to drive strategic projects from problem definition through delivery, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Lead cross-functional initiatives by coordinating with stakeholders, managing dependencies, resolving blockers, and ensuring timely completion of deliverables.
Analyze existing business processes and functional requirements to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
Translate business objectives into clear and detailed process specifications, product requirements, project plans, and actionable recommendations.
Support the development and delivery of product and process specifications that meet business needs and stakeholder expectations.
Facilitate working sessions with subject-matter experts and business partners, driving consensus and decision-making while escalating issues when necessary.
Advise business teams on prioritization, resource allocation, project risks, and potential delivery challenges to ensure successful project execution.
Create executive-ready presentations, project updates, proposals, and strategic recommendations to communicate progress and insights effectively.
Leverage advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables and data analysis, to organize information, identify insights, and support data-driven decision-making.
Utilize AI-enabled productivity tools such as ChatGPT and Codex to enhance research, documentation, and workflow efficiency.
Ensure all project deliverables align with business specifications, stakeholder expectations, and organizational policies, maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.

Benefits

Oracle offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance plans, retirement savings options, and paid time off. Employees have access to continuous learning opportunities, including training programs and certifications to foster career development. The company promotes a flexible and inclusive work environment, encouraging work-life balance and diversity. Additionally, Oracle provides various wellness programs, employee assistance programs, and resources to support mental and physical health. Joining Oracle means becoming part of a global community committed to innovation, collaboration, and making an impact in the technology industry.

Equal Opportunity

Oracle is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our collective success. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and excellence, and we are committed to providing equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Business Analist

Maak impact op het snijvlak van business, IT en verandering

Krijg jij energie van complexe vraagstukken, het verbeteren van processen en het vertalen van businessbehoeften naar slimme digitale oplossingen? En ben jij iemand die niet alleen analyseert, maar ook richting geeft en een team weet mee te nemen?

Als Business Analist binnen onze Application Services (AS) practice speel je een belangrijke rol in uitdagende digitale transformatieprojecten bij onze klanten.
Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen business en IT. Je doorgrondt complexe processen, stelt de juiste vragen en weet snel tot de kern van een vraagstuk te komen. Vervolgens vertaal je inzichten naar concrete requirements, verbeterinitiatieven en oplossingen waar zowel stakeholders als ontwikkelteams mee verder kunnen.
Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen je eigen werkzaamheden. Vanuit jouw ervaring neem je collega's mee, breng je structuur wanneer zaken nog niet duidelijk zijn en help je het team om gezamenlijk tot de beste oplossing te komen.

Wat ga je doen?

Geen project is hetzelfde. De ene keer duik je diep in een complex bedrijfsproces, de andere keer begeleid je stakeholders bij het bepalen van requirements of help je een team om een digitale oplossing verder vorm te geven.
Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:
Het analyseren van complexe bedrijfsprocessen, systemen en informatiebehoeften.
Het achterhalen van de vraag achter de vraag en het vertalen daarvan naar concrete oplossingen.
Het vertalen van businessbehoeften naar duidelijke requirements, user stories en functionele ontwerpen.
Het begeleiden van stakeholders bij het bepalen van doelstellingen, prioriteiten en verwachtingen.
Het structureren en beheren van requirements en productbacklogs.
Het in kaart brengen van processen, informatiestromen en afhankelijkheden door middel van procesmodellen, diagrammen en workflows.
Het identificeren van knelpunten en verbeterkansen binnen bestaande processen en systemen.
Het begeleiden van workshops, refinements en andere sessies met business- en IT-stakeholders.
Het adviseren van klanten over procesoptimalisatie en passende digitale oplossingen.
Het inhoudelijk meenemen van collega's en projectteams en het creëren van draagvlak voor keuzes en veranderingen.
Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling, coaching en continue verbetering binnen het team.

Wat neem je mee?

We zoeken een ervaren Business Analist die analytisch sterk is, overzicht houdt en mensen weet mee te krijgen.
Je hoeft niet ieder vakje af te vinken. Wel zien we graag dat je jezelf in een groot deel van onderstaande punten herkent:
Je hebt een afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Informatica, Information Management, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring als Business Analist, Informatie Analist, Functioneel Analist of in een vergelijkbare rol.
Je bent analytisch sterk en in staat om complexe vraagstukken snel te doorgronden.
Je bent gewend om zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en binnen projecten inhoudelijk richting te geven.
Je weet collega's en stakeholders mee te nemen in jouw analyses, keuzes en oplossingsrichtingen.
Je hebt ervaring met Agile/Scrum en bent vertrouwd met user stories, refinements en backlogmanagement.
Je hebt ervaring met procesmodellering, BPM, UML, workflows of vergelijkbare methodieken.
Je kunt complexe informatie eenvoudig en begrijpelijk overbrengen aan verschillende doelgroepen.
Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met zowel business stakeholders als technische teams.
Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en weet verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen.
Je communiceert uitstekend in zowel Nederlands als Engels.
Je werkt gestructureerd, bent kritisch wanneer nodig en houdt tegelijkertijd het grotere geheel in het oog.

Mooi meegenomen

Extra interessant wordt het wanneer je daarnaast ervaring hebt met één of meerdere van onderstaande onderwerpen:
Business- of Enterprise Architectuur.
TOGAF.
Certificeringen zoals IREB, BABOK/IIBA, BiSL, ITIL, ISQI/CABA of BCS.
SQL, Microsoft Access of andere databronnen.
Projecten binnen de publieke sector, financiële dienstverlening of maakindustrie.
Het faciliteren van workshops en adviestrajecten.
Het coachen of inhoudelijk begeleiden van andere Business Analisten.

Hoe jij het verschil maakt

Jij neemt niet zomaar een requirement over, maar wilt begrijpen waarom iets nodig is.
Je durft door te vragen, verbanden te leggen en aannames ter discussie te stellen. Wanneer een vraagstuk nog onduidelijk is, creëer jij structuur en overzicht. Je brengt mensen samen, maakt complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk en helpt stakeholders om tot duidelijke keuzes te komen.
Tegelijkertijd ben je iemand die het team verder brengt. Je deelt je kennis, neemt collega's mee in jouw denkwijze en bent niet bang om inhoudelijk het voortouw te nemen wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt.

Kortom: je combineert sterke analytische vaardigheden met leiderschap, stakeholdermanagement en een goed gevoel voor business én technologie.
Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten om organisaties, teams én digitale oplossingen daadwerkelijk verder te brengen? Dan komen we graag met je in gesprek.

new_jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title:
Senior Specialist, Systems Engineering – Space Intelligence Analyst (Active TS/SCI w/ CI Poly Required)

Job Code:
42795

Job Location:
Springfield, Virginia (100% On-site)

Job Schedule:
5/8 Monday-Friday

Job Description:

L3Harris Technologies currently has an opening for a Senior Specialist, Systems Engineer – Space Intelligence Analyst for an important national security program. The successful candidate will join a high-performing team of Government and Contractor professionals supporting real-time space operations. This role is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and assessing space-related activities to provide mission status updates, anomaly investigations, recommended courses of action (COAs), and decision support information to senior leaders in support of the Space Warfighting Mission.

The Space Intelligence Analyst will play a critical role in maintaining the health and safety of both ground and space assets, as well as associated infrastructure nodes. The ideal candidate will have direct experience in space operations, familiarity with COA and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTP) development, and a solid understanding of the Space Warfighting construct.

This position requires the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities and tasking. " role with TaskUs:

with expertise in transforming data into insight within the social science field. This position involves regular collaboration with teams across regions. While the role follows standard working hours, occasional flexibility may be needed to support global initiatives.

new_jobs.description:
Department of State – International Narcotics and Law Enforcement (INL)

Washington, DC | Onsite | Full-Time

About Us

Totally Joined for Achieving Collaborative Techniques (TJFACT) is a minority-owned, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) delivering mission-focused professional services and technology solutions to the U.S. Government. Our teams support critical federal missions through collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence while building lasting partnerships with our customers, employees, and industry partners.

About This Position

TJFACT is seeking a well-qualified Program Analyst
to support the Department of State – INL/ACB
office ,
in Washington, DC
. This position is equivalent to a Program/ Management Analyst Level 3.

This position is located in the Cybercrime and Illicit Finance Branch of ACB’s Cross Border Programs Division. The Cybercrime and Illicit Finance team designs and implements programming to disrupt criminal networks that profit from cybercrime and illicit finance, with the goal of making perpetrators more visible and vulnerable to investigation, prosecution, and conviction. Programming strengthens legislative and regulatory frameworks; builds law enforcement, prosecutorial, and financial investigative capabilities; expands cross-border digital evidence sharing and cryptocurrency tracing skills; and enables coordinated international action to dismantle cybercriminal infrastructure and money laundering networks. These efforts are intended to increase arrests, prosecutions, convictions, extraditions, and asset seizures—directly reducing the threat cybercrime and illicit finance threat to American families, businesses, and critical infrastructure. INL/ACB works with other U.S. agencies—including DOJ, FBI, DHS, and FinCEN—as well as international organizations such as INTERPOL, UNODC, OAS, and the Egmont Group, to implement these programs. This position provides programmatic development and oversight to the INL/ACB Cybercrime and Illicit Finance Team projects.

Please note: This position is being recruited in support of a TPC proposal effort. Any offer of employment is contingent upon contract award and successful completion of all pre-employment requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Drafts statements of work to meet U.S. foreign policy goals, coordinates with the interagency, and works with procurement and budgetary offices to ensure funding is secured and to monitor initiatives and programs.
Drafts a variety of technical, programmatic, funding, and informational memoranda and letters; assists in the preparation of responses to Congressional questions, press guidance, and interagency documents in accordance with Department policies and regulations.
Assists with logistical and program management support for funding agreements, including through securing specialized grants training; manage budget process including production and processing of obligating documents such as interagency agreements and letters of agreement; assist in overseeing project implementation and project site visits in country; assist with the maintenance of funding and budgetary spreadsheets pertaining to task order and program management; and provide assistance to the Branch Chief on drafting, reviewing and amending all manner of procurement requests and task orders as assigned.
Advises on the management and oversight of programs to advance support on cybercrime, cryptocurrency crime, malicious cyber infrastructure, online child sexual exploitation, and illicit finance efforts.
Assists in the oversight, monitoring, reporting, coordination, and assessment of INL programs to ensure deliverables and foreign assistance priorities set by the Department of State are being fulfilled.
Develops and maintains comprehensive knowledge of issues related to cybercrime, cryptocurrency-enabled crime, and transnational illicit finance.
Serves as an advisory resource for INL/ACB on specific aspects of planning and implementation of programs.
Establish and maintain professional relationships with office and other INL colleagues, Department and interagency colleagues including agencies involved in programming, and USG personnel assigned to U.S. Embassies that are associated with implementing programs and policy processes.
Ensures that INL/ACB and the INL Front Office receive timely information and reporting to ensure that senior Department, interagency, and budget briefings are fully informed of developments on the ground.
Prepares background materials and reports used in preparing reports, speeches, briefings, and testimony to articulate INL engagement.

Required Qualifications

U.S. Citizen
Ability to maintain a Department of State security clearance
A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution
Four (4) to six (6) years’ experience in relevant field
Ability to operate independently, employing oversight over existing and future operations and procurements.
Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with a wide range of players;
Proven knowledge of Federal policies and procedures including methods of providing assistance and the Federal budget process;
Demonstrated ability to provide advice, guidance, and consultation with regard to the interpretation and application of analysis;
Experience drafting US government reports and documents, such as briefing papers, talking points, meeting reports, and other documents;
Demonstrated knowledge of monitoring and evaluation of foreign assistance programming and/or other international program evaluation, including specialized knowledge of international programs sufficient to ensure project work is in compliance with management policies and procedures and in conformance with the Foreign Assistance Act and other regulatory procedures and guidelines;
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience with and knowledge of the State Department's foreign assistance process, the structure and hierarchy of U.S. embassies, and State Department policies and processes.
Demonstrated experience working or coordinating with other relevant U.S. government agencies (e.g., Department of Justice components such as CCIPS and CEOS, FBI, DHS, and FinCEN) engaged on cybercrime and illicit finance issues and the federal law enforcement/criminal justice community more broadly.
Demonstrated experience working on criminal justice reform or anti-money laundering/countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) issues within the U.S. Government.

Benefits

401(k) with Company Match
Paid Time Off
Paid Holidays
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is growing, and we have an exciting career opportunity for a Lead Senior Project Manager
to support our Site Investigation & Remediation (SIR) Business Line in Houston, TX; San Antonio, TX; Dallas/Fort Worth, TX; Austin, TX; El Paso, TX; New Orleans, LA; Shreveport, LA or Baton Rouge, LA
offices. We are seeking a motivated and experienced professional who is excited about the opportunity to help expand our environmental consulting business across Texas.

As part of the team, you will have access to an unparalleled network of technical experts and resources, along with endless opportunities to collaborate on impactful projects with diverse teammates across the globe. This role offers the chance to work with an established engineering consulting firm that values employee enthusiasm, technical excellence, and leadership.

At WSP, we are dedicated to fostering an environment where individuals can grow their careers, take on challenging and meaningful work, and contribute to a wide range of diverse clients and projects. Our ideal candidate is committed to quality, thrives in a collaborative setting, and is motivated to deliver first‑class environmental consulting services while helping to mentor and develop future leaders.

Why Choose WSP?

At WSP, we shape environments for the future and deliver solutions that benefit our communities and the natural environment. Our Employee Value Proposition reflects our commitment to our people and the careers they build with us.

With us, you can:

Collaborate openly with multidisciplinary teams that value diverse perspectives and inclusive teamwork
Stay curious by working on complex environmental challenges that encourage innovation and continuous learning
Be passionate about meaningful work that delivers real‑world impact for clients and communities
Be adaptable and shape a career path supported by flexibility, mentorship, and global opportunities

At WSP, you’ll be empowered to do the work the world needs—supported by a people‑first culture that prioritizes professional growth, well‑being, and long‑term success.

Your Impact

Identify and develop new clients for WSP’s environmental business through internal and external networking.
Manage environmental projects involving site characterization, remedial design, and environmental compliance, ensuring deliverables, schedules, and budgets are achieved.
Perform field work for site characterization and remediation projects, including oversight of subcontractors and sampling of soil, soil vapor, sediment, surface water, and groundwater in accordance with state and federal regulations and accepted protocols.
Conduct data analysis and reporting for environmental project tasks with minimal supervision; recommend remedial solutions using accepted scientific and engineering practices.
Provide technical review to ensure compliance with environmental laws, company standards, contract requirements, and specifications.
Travel to project sites primarily within Texas and occasionally across the mountain states of the West; minimal overnight travel required.
Develop and maintain effective communication with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution and high‑quality service delivery.
Mentor and train junior staff, supporting their professional development and preparing project teams for expanded responsibilities.
Manage and coordinate project teams, ensuring the technical quality of deliverables
Collaborate and participate in technical discussions with internal teams.
Support business development efforts in the public and private sectors.
Manage proposal preparation, including innovative technical approaches, competitive pricing, and client presentations.
Manage technical, budgetary, and schedule performance to achieve client satisfaction and repeat business.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and company policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Engineering or a related field
PG or PE required (Texas registration preferred)
10+ years of progressively responsible experience
Strong background providing environmental consulting services to industrial/commercial, mining, energy, and government clients
Proven experience with growing existing client portfolio’s and developing new client opportunities.
Demonstrated expertise with federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including TRRP
Proven experience with environmental site investigations, remediation, field management, and sampling programs
Project management experience including oversight of deliverables, schedules, and budgets
Self‑starter with strong teamwork skills and excellent written and verbal communication abilities
Proficiency with standard software tools including MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Ability to travel primarily within Texas with occasional travel to western mountain states; minimal overnight travel
Must pass a background check and maintain a satisfactory driving record in accordance with the Company’s MVR policy.

Preferred Qualification

Master’s degree in Environmental Engineering or a related field

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

new_jobs.title: Senior Operations Analyst (SRE)
new_jobs.description:
Position Description

CGI's Advantage Cloud Operations is an SRE-driven operating model, anchored on an Operations Control Plane that unifies telemetry, event management, automation, and IT Service Management (ITSM). The Senior Operations Analyst is a senior Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practitioner responsible for driving reliability engineering, problem management, and runbook automation across customer environments. This role also mentors the operations team in adopting proactive, data-driven operational practices while improving platform reliability, operational efficiency, and service quality.

This position can be performed from any CGI U.S. CSG office, with a preference for Lafayette, LA.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Reliability Engineering & Operations Leadership

Serve as a senior SRE within the Cloud Operations team supporting the CGI Advantage platform.
Own end-to-end reliability outcomes, including reducing MTTD and MTTR, minimizing escalations, and improving release safety.
Lead incident response, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Problem Management activities.
Design and implement automation and self-healing workflows with appropriate guardrails, approvals, and rollback capabilities.
Act as the technical lead for the Operations technology stack and drive platform adoption.
Mentor Operations Analysts while establishing operational standards, taxonomy, and Service Level Objective (SLO) discipline.

Observability & Incident Response

Drive distributed tracing adoption using OpenTelemetry with trace-to-log and metric correlation for priority services.
Define SLO-aligned alerting strategies and optimize deduplication, suppression, and event correlation to reduce alert noise.
Lead Sev 1 and Sev 2 incident bridges while ensuring evidence-based RCAs and corrective actions are completed.
Standardize dashboards and observability signal sets across customer environments.

Automation & Problem Management

Build and maintain an active automation backlog and deliver automated runbooks on a quarterly basis.
Convert recurring incidents into problem records with RCA hypotheses, ownership, and due dates.
Develop guard-railed self-service operational actions (diagnostics, restarts, environment tasks) utilizing RBAC and audit trails.
Champion Configuration-as-Code practices, including version control, drift detection, and baseline versus override governance.

Release Safety & Security

Enforce release gates, quality thresholds, and automated rollback to the last known good state.
Implement time-bound privileged access (JIT/Break Glass), SSO integration, and audit-ready operational controls.
Apply Policy-as-Code guardrails across Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes admission controls, and CI/CD pipelines.

Leadership & Governance

Mentor and upskill Operations Analysts while documenting and promoting "golden path" operational workflows.
Report reliability KPIs including: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) , Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) , First Touch Resolution , Automation Coverage
Partner with Product, Delivery, ITSM, and Security teams within a matrix operating model.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

6–9 years in cloud operations/SRE, including 3+ years operating production SaaS on Azure.
Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, log analytics, metrics, and dashboards.
Kubernetes at scale: AKS, Calico network policy, KEDA autoscaling, Helm based deployments.
IaC and configuration: Terraform; GitOps with GitHub Actions and Argo CD.
Event management and orchestration: event correlation, auto remediation workflows.
Scripting/automation: strong Python and Bash; API driven integration across ITSM and tooling.
Security tooling: Keycloak/ SSO, Azure Key Vault, cert manager, JIT access patterns.
ITSM depth: incident/problem/change management, severity taxonomy, SLA/SLO reporting.

Preferred Experience

Policy as code (OPA, Kyverno, Conftest) and compliance grade audit reporting.
Job/batch orchestration (JS7 or equivalent) and API gateway operations (APISIX/APIM).
PostgreSQL operations, PgBouncer connection pooling, and managed database patterns.
Multi tenant managed services delivery with contractual SLA/SLO obligations.
Certifications: CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator/Architect, ITIL 4.

CGI expects to accept applications for this position through 9/30/2026.
